title: Spec: dangling 4.6 cross-reference in spec/02 4.2
description: spec/02-physical-link.md line ~300 (4.2 Key Selection Policy) says 'Relay nodes that re-sign frames (see 4.6)' but spec/02 has no section 4.6 (4.1-4.5 only). The relay re-sign normative text lives in spec/06-security.md 8.4 (the section relay.rs cites). Fix the reference to point at the actual relay re-sign section (or add the 4.6 section). Found during project-LICHEN-worker6-yg8b (Rust TOFU key-selection conformance).
